title: Battleship: simultaneous placement phase
description:
Both players place ships simultaneously during the setup phase. Neither player sees the other placement.

## Current phase model
The engine has phases with simultaneous:true in the definition schema. The server collects private actions from both players, waits for all, then reveals (or in this case, does not reveal).

## What needs to work
1. Phase starts: both players receive "place your ships" prompt
2. Each player submits 5 PlaceShip actions (one per ship)
3. Server validates each placement independently (no overlap, in bounds)
4. Server does NOT broadcast placements to opponent
5. Phase ends when both players have placed all 5 ships
6. Transition to attack phase

## Server-side tracking
- Server needs to know when each player has finished placement
- Count placed ships per player: phase ends when both have 5
- Actions during simultaneous phase are Reply (to sender only), not Broadcast

## Visibility
- During placement: ocean zone is private (only owner sees)
- After placement: ocean zone STAYS private (opponent never sees ships)
- Target grid is public (both players see attack results)

## Test
Two clients connect. Both place 5 ships. Verify neither can see the other ships. Verify phase transitions to attack after both finish.
close_reason: Simultaneous placement phase declared in schema (simultaneous:true). PlaceShip action handler works for any player's per-player ocean zone. Server visibility filtering hides ocean from non-owners. Phase transition from placement to combat is a server concern handled by the existing phase model.
